expectations.text: States this is not a firmware bug and that adding a delay or retrying play() cannot work because the AVPlay native session is dead
expectations.evidence: not a firmware bug; retry/timeout cannot revive a dead native session

expectations.text: Identifies that pause() alone on background leaves the decoder / AVPlay session / DRM session held, and the platform reclaims it (especially when the live-TV tuner takes the shared plane)
expectations.evidence: pause() alone leaves decoder/AVPlay/DRM held; tuner reclaims the shared plane

expectations.text: Fix tears the player down on background with avplay.stop() then avplay.close() (releasing the instance), not just pause()
expectations.evidence: release on hidden: stop() -> close() (release instance), save playhead; suspend()/restore() explicitly rejected as primary

expectations.text: Fix rebuilds the pipeline on resume (open/prepareAsync + seek to a saved playhead) instead of calling play() on the stale instance
expectations.evidence: rebuild on visible: open -> setDisplayRect -> prepareAsync -> seekTo -> play

expectations.text: Frames it as the general rule: release the media pipeline and GPU/DRM resources when leaving the foreground
expectations.evidence: framed as the general rule: release media pipeline + GPU/DRM on leaving foreground
